statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Post-reopen NQ evidence is two-sided, and no persistent mean-reversion failure is currently verified.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The next concentrated Tail checkpoint is the first post-holiday U.S. cash open, where gap persistence and pullback quality can change the regime.
headline: Nasdaq Tail stays low as the holiday reopen remains two-sided
body: Delayed post-reopen NQ snapshots show movement through roughly 29,550-29,650 rather than sustained extreme holding. Fresh shared context is conflicting: semiconductors are broadly positive, megacaps are mostly negative, and delayed VIX and WTI are higher. Gulf escalation keeps Stress extreme.

sources.title: Reuters — Iran warns U.S. energy assets in Gulf are vulnerable
Reuters — UBS forecasts two U.S. Fed rate hikes after strong jobs report

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock-hours are available. Tail ranged 18%-24%, Stress remained 100%, and the prior day stayed predominantly event/whipsaw before the post-reopen score returned to low.
outlookSummary: Base Tail remains low overnight because the holiday reopen is not showing verified persistent one-way structure. The main conditional risk concentration is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open; only unrepaired directional continuation with failed pullbacks lifts Tail into the blocking band.

forecast.analysis: Observed post-reopen delayed quotes have moved through roughly 29,550-29,650 inside a broader 29,530.5-29,683.5 range. The two-sided path argues against persistent mean-reversion failure, while Gulf and oil risk keeps Stress extreme.
drivers: No verified persistent extension near a session extreme
Fresh Gulf and oil risk remains severe

forecast.analysis: Conditional 01:00: Tail stays low if overnight trade continues rotating through the reopen range. A renewed directional push matters only if pullbacks become shallow and prior levels stop repairing.
drivers: Failed-retracement evidence would invalidate the low-Tail base case

forecast.analysis: Conditional 02:00: sustained overlap and retracement depth would reinforce mean reversion. A clean second leg that holds near an overnight extreme would lift Tail toward WATCH.
Conditional 03:00: Asian liquidity should clarify whether the holiday-reopen move is being absorbed. Balanced rotation keeps Tail low; repeated extension without repair would raise it.
drivers: Holiday-reopen gap repair remains the key structure check

forecast.analysis: Conditional 04:00: Tail remains low if volatility decays and the overnight range broadens in both directions. Fresh Gulf escalation could raise Stress quickly without automatically creating a one-way NQ path.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 05:00: a stable overnight range favors continued mean reversion. A fresh breakout would need failed pullbacks and repeated extension before Tail moves materially higher.
drivers: Breakout quality matters more than breakout size

forecast.analysis: Conditional 06:00: pre-Europe structure remains low Tail if price is not pinned near an extreme. Persistent extreme holding with aligned oil or rates pressure would increase risk.
Conditional 07:00: Europe-open flows raise transition risk but not yet the Tail band. An unrepaired overnight trend plus directional cross-asset confirmation would move the regime toward WATCH.
Conditional 08:00: the first European hour should reveal whether opening flows fade or extend. Reversal back into the overnight range favors low Tail; repeated extension would not.
Conditional 09:00: normalization after Europe opens would reduce directional efficiency. Tail stays low unless NQ starts holding near an extreme with shallow retracements.
Conditional 10:00: absent a fresh catalyst, two-sided European trade keeps Tail low. Oil remains an inflationary Stress amplifier, not standalone proof of persistent NQ continuation.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 11:00: U.S. premarket participation can widen swings. Tail stays low if moves retrace; a catalyst-aligned break that repeatedly rejects pullbacks would raise risk.
Conditional 12:00: pre-cash positioning increases headline and rates sensitivity. Tail remains below WATCH unless price becomes directionally efficient and stops repairing intraday dislocations.

forecast.analysis: Conditional 13:00: the danger window begins at 13:20 UTC. Tail rises to WATCH because the first post-holiday U.S. cash auction can amplify gaps; blocking evidence still requires shallow or failed pullbacks and repeated extension.

Conditional 14:00: Tail reaches elevated only if the cash open produces a directional gap or impulse that resists repair, holds near an extreme, and extends again after weak pullbacks. Two-sided opening trade would invalidate this path.

Conditional 15:00: WATCH reflects first-hour aftershock risk. Tail falls below the blocking threshold if opening dislocations repair; it would stay elevated only with persistent one-way follow-through.
drivers: Persistent continuation would keep Tail elevated

forecast.analysis: Conditional 16:00: post-open stabilization should reduce Tail to WATCH. A renewed second leg after an apparently successful retracement would be the main adverse structure.
Conditional 17:00: normal two-sided afternoon trade would return Tail to low. Fresh geopolitical or rate shocks could re-widen Stress without automatically changing Tail.
Conditional 18:00: Tail stays low if the cash session remains rotational and no side holds near extremes. Persistent breadth and megacap alignment would be needed to strengthen a directional case.

Conditional 19:00: Federal Reserve Consumer Credit is a medium-impact checkpoint. Tail moves to WATCH only for an outsized market reaction that becomes persistent; the scheduled release itself is not Tail evidence.
Conditional 20:00: after the Consumer Credit release, orderly digestion and retracement keep Tail low. A surprise matters mainly through the observed price path rather than the release label.
drivers: Observed reaction matters more than event importance

forecast.analysis: Conditional 21:00: late cash-session balance would favor low Tail. A fresh one-way push into the close would require cross-asset confirmation to justify a higher score.
drivers: Cross-asset confirmation for any closing trend

forecast.analysis: Conditional 22:00: after the cash close, thinner futures liquidity lowers confidence slightly. Tail remains low if the session closes with repaired dislocations and no persistent extreme holding.
Conditional 23:00: the overnight handoff remains low Tail under a balanced close. New geopolitical discontinuity or a renewed no-retracement futures move would invalidate that base case.
